successCriteria.description: The LeaveType enum exports exactly six members with lowercase string values: annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity — matching the controlled vocabulary in the reconciled architecture.
The LeaveStatus enum exports exactly five members with uppercase string values: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED — matching the LeaveRequest lifecycle states.
The AuditAction enum exports exactly seven members with uppercase string values: CREATED, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED, BALANCE_DEDUCTED, BALANCE_RESTORED.
The LeaveRequestDTO interface is exported with status typed as LeaveStatus (not a raw string) and nullable fields (approvedBy, approvedAt, cancelledAt) typed as string | null.
The LeaveBalanceDTO interface is exported with status typed as the literal union 'ACTIVE' | 'EXHAUSTED' | 'FROZEN' (not a raw string or enum).

The barrel index.ts re-exports all five public symbols — LeaveType, LeaveStatus, AuditAction (as values) and LeaveRequestDTO, LeaveBalanceDTO (as types) — so downstream modules import exclusively from src/shared/types/index.ts.
A Jest unit test at tests/unit/shared/types/enums.test.ts (using the .test.ts convention) runs and passes, asserting each enum's exact member count, member presence, and string-value casing.

The shared-types module compiles cleanly under strict TypeScript (no implicit any, strict null checks) with zero use of the any type — nullable fields use string | null and variant fields use union types.

constraints: No use of the any type anywhere in the shared-types module (HARNESS.json no-any rule, severity high); use unknown with type guards or explicit union/literal types instead.
The shared-types module must have zero external runtime dependencies — it stands alone (only TypeScript type/enum definitions and a Jest test).
Test files must use the .test.ts extension and live under the tests/ directory mirroring the src/ structure (AGENTS.md convention); do not create .spec.ts files.
The module must compile under strict TypeScript (strict null checks, no implicit any) as configured in tsconfig; tests are excluded from tsc and compiled by ts-jest.
No database access occurs in this phase — shared-types is a pure type/enum module with no repository or service layer (GP-001 repository pattern does not apply yet).
outOfScope: The audit module (AuditRecord entity, IAuditRepository, AuditService) — the reconciled architecture groups it under "Phase 1: Shared types and audit foundation" but this planner phase covers only the shared-types module; audit is a later phase.

The LeaveType entity interface (id, code, label, description, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt) — this is a domain entity owned by the leave-policy module in a later phase, not the LeaveType enum in shared-types.

Domain entity interfaces with Date-typed fields (LeaveRequest, LeaveBalance, Employee, LeavePolicy) — those are module-owned entities in later phases; this phase only defines DTOs with ISO-string fields.
Any repository, service, controller, or routes layer — this phase produces only types, enums, and a unit test.

Input validation logic (GP-003), RBAC enforcement (GP-005), and audit-record writing (GP-002) — these apply to state-changing operations and API boundaries, none of which exist in a pure types module.

entityInvariants.invariant: The enum is a closed controlled vocabulary of exactly six leave categories; no member may be added or removed without an architecture change. Values are lowercase to match the leave_types.code database column.

The enum enumerates the complete LeaveRequest lifecycle: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → (APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED), with DRAFT → CANCELLED also permitted. APPROVED, REJECTED, and CANCELLED are terminal states. No intermediate status may exist outside this set.

The enum covers every state-changing action that must produce an audit record per GP-002: request lifecycle transitions (CREATED, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED) plus balance mutations (BALANCE_DEDUCTED, BALANCE_RESTORED). No state-changing operation may use an action outside this set.

The status field is constrained to the LeaveStatus enum (not a free string), so every DTO instance can only carry a valid lifecycle state; the DTO is a transport shape with ISO-string dates, distinct from the Date-typed LeaveRequest domain entity.

The status field is constrained to the literal union 'ACTIVE' | 'EXHAUSTED' | 'FROZEN', matching the LeaveBalance lifecycle; the DTO is a transport shape with ISO-string dates, distinct from the Date-typed LeaveBalance domain entity.

interfaceConstraints.operation: Import all shared-types symbols from the barrel entry point src/shared/types/index.ts
interfaceConstraints.authRule: N/A — pure type module, no auth surface.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: A missing or misnamed export must surface as a TypeScript compile error at the import site, not a runtime failure.

interfaceConstraints.operation: Use LeaveStatus as the type of LeaveRequestDTO.status (DTO references the enum, not a duplicate string literal)
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Assigning a status outside the LeaveStatus set must be a compile-time type error.

interfaceConstraints.operation: Run the enums unit test via the configured Jest runner (npx jest)
interfaceConstraints.authRule: N/A — no auth in unit tests.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: A missing enum member or wrong casing must fail the test with a clear assertion message; the test must not pass silently on an incomplete enum.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The LeaveType enum values must match the controlled vocabulary declared in the reconciled architecture (annual, sick, emergency, unpaid, maternity, paternity) and the leave_types.code column casing.

The LeaveStatus enum must match the LeaveRequest lifecycle states declared in the reconciled architecture (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED) and the leave_requests.status column casing.
The LeaveBalanceDTO.status union ('ACTIVE' | 'EXHAUSTED' | 'FROZEN') must match the LeaveBalance lifecycle declared in the reconciled architecture and the leave_balances.status column values.

The module boundary for shared-types (src/shared/types/) and its ownership of the three enums and two DTOs must match the Module Boundaries section of ARCHITECTURE.md; do not relocate or duplicate these symbols in another module.

The test file naming and location must follow the AGENTS.md convention (.test.ts under tests/ mirroring src/), not the .spec.ts path mentioned in PLAN.md's prose — the clarification and AGENTS.md override the plan's filename.

integrationPoints.why: Imports LeaveStatus and LeaveRequestDTO from src/shared/types/index.ts to type the request lifecycle and transport shape.
Imports LeaveType and LeaveBalanceDTO from src/shared/types/index.ts to type balance scoping and transport shape.
Imports AuditAction from src/shared/types/index.ts to type audit record actions per GP-002.
All depend on shared-types per the reconciled dependency map; they import enums/DTOs exclusively through the barrel index.ts.
